title: ArnoldiGCL: Graph Contrastive Learning via Learnable Arnoldi-Based Guided Spectral Chebyshev Polynomial Filters

problem.claim: Graph Contrastive Learning is used for self-supervised graph representation learning, including on heterophilic graphs.

gap.claim: Existing approaches simplify low-pass and high-pass filters as basic linear operations, which may fail to capture complex topological relationships because of numerical considerations.

narrative_sequence.summary: Graph Contrastive Learning is presented as a powerful paradigm for self-supervised graph representation learning.
Spectral graph neural networks improve GCL on heterophilic graphs by incorporating low-pass and high-pass filters.
Existing filter approaches oversimplify these operations and fail to capture complex topological relationships.
